description: This file defines middleware and helper functions for tenant-based filtering in a MongoDB/Mongoose context, including utilities to filter objects, queries, and aggregations based on tenant ID, and middleware to attach tenant info to requests.

methods.name: tenantScope
methods.description: Returns Express middleware that attaches tenant filtering helpers and tenant info to the request object.

methods.name: filterObject
methods.description: Adds tenant_id to an object if not present, based on tenantId.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Modifies a Mongoose query to include tenant_id filtering if not already set.

methods.name: applyToAggregation
methods.description: Prepends a $match stage with tenant_id to an aggregation pipeline if not already present.

methods.name: stampCreate
methods.description: Sets tenant_id on a document if missing, based on tenantId.
